blockers.resolution: Inventory and classify every in-scope calculation and module before any coverage or release claim.

Inventory the display projection in src/shared/python/body_part_viz/axial_loads.py and the native/analytical source adapters before a manual coverage claim. Projection is proximal parent-on-segment reaction onto the declared segment axis, tension positive; it is not a stress or human-safety metric.

Classify reference fitting, URDF/MJCF kinematic adapters, and selected-pose similarity registration under src/motion_capture/reference before a manual coverage claim. Surface-marker proxy fits and synthetic FK parity do not qualify anatomical accuracy, camera calibration, global optimality, or native dynamics.
